fields.statement: QA at c90d32c99 with a binary built from the branch (go build -trimpath), run by hand in a scratch Rhiza root with its own HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and TMPDIR, plus the script's fake rex and fake claude (the fake makes $TMPDIR/claude-test/<cwd>/<session-id>/scratchpad and runs rhiza slice so the worktree gets an index). I started a build-hold run (stopped at its wait, --no-wait) and a build-done run that succeeded. After the success, the ended run's session scratch folder was gone; the live run's scratch folder and both index DBs stayed, as did an unrelated $TMPDIR/claude-test/other/keep. `rhiza run abandon` on the live run printed 'remove-worktree done' and removed its worktree, its session scratch folder and its index DB, while the ended run's index stayed. I also checked that the real Claude Code layout on this host ($TMPDIR=/home/rhiza/tmp, /home/rhiza/tmp/claude-1000/<encoded cwd>/<session id>) is matched by the adapter's claude-*/*/<id> pattern.

QA at c90d32c99 with the built binary in the same scratch root, after the run-end scenario. I removed the ended run's worktree by hand with git worktree remove, so its index DB became an orphan. I recreated that ended session's scratch folder and aged it 2 days (touch -d), and recreated the abandoned run's session folder fresh. I also added an aged folder for a session ID nobody recorded. `rhiza daemon --once --max-runs 0 --permission-mode manual` logged 'rhiza: daemon: leftovers sweep freed 120.9 KiB: 1 index databases, 1 session scratch folders'. The orphan index and the aged ended-session folder were gone. The fresh folder, the unrecorded-session folder and other/keep stayed. A new live run (stopped at its wait) whose scratch folder I aged 3 days kept its folder and its index across another daemon --once, which logged no sweep line. I did not exercise the hourly spacing by hand; it is covered by TestDaemonSweepLeftovers with an injected clock.
